away.summary: The Golden Knights (15-6-5) are coming off a 5-3 win over the Edmonton Oilers and have won two straight, going 6-1-4 in November. They practiced with the same lineup from that victory, though Noah Hanifin is injured. Carter Hart is listed first among the projected goaltenders.

home.summary: The Sharks (11-13-2) are coming off a 7-0 loss to the Anaheim Ducks and held an optional practice Thursday. Luca Cagnoni and Cam Lund were recalled from the AHL, but coach Ryan Warsofsky did not confirm if either will play; Brett Leason and Libor Hajek were reassigned. Yaroslav Askarov is listed first among the projected goaltenders.
